title: Will your paywall get flagged?
source: Source: Apple App Store Review Guidelines 3.1.2 · Google Play subscriptions policy

lines.text: Apple and Google ask apps to show clear subscription terms.
Price. Billing period. Restore. Terms. Privacy.
lines.title: Paywall must-haves

lines.text: Miss one? It *may* get flagged. That can cost you *days*.
Check yours in *30 seconds*. Free. No sign-up.
